Welcome to Scientific Draw Odds.

Every year, I spend a lot of time thinking about my big game draws. For most states, this involves making my own model. Given that I’ve been doing most of the work anyway, I decided to publish my results for free.

This is a community service, not a “free trial.” There’s no account needed or strings attached. To use my website, select a state, input your residency/points information, and load the spreadsheet. I also include my notes for each state.

Best of luck in your draws, as long as you’re not applying for my units!

::: {.signature}
